message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO," dated "1-7 APRIL 2024." The masthead is red, above the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The background is light blue. 

On the left, a large building features a distinctive, rounded, green-ribbed roof. In the foreground, a brown, vertical-barred metal gate is closed between two rectangular, tan-colored pillars. A person in a red coat and black trousers crouches behind the left pillar, peering around it toward the building. On the right side of the gate, a person wearing a white shirt and blue trousers hunches over, looking through the bars toward the left. Both figures are shown from behind or in profile, with simplified, rounded body shapes. 

Text on the right reads "SAT-SET MENGHALAU ANGKET." Below this, smaller black text states: "Partai pendukung Anies Baswedan dan Ganjar Pranowo tak solid mendorong hak angket kecurangan pemilu di DPR. Tergiur iming-iming kursi menteri. H.22." Additional headlines at the top mention "Ferienjob" and "Bohir Pasir." A barcode and QR code are in the upper right.
